Here is a conversational, low-pressure guide you can use to chat with your passengers. Because cybersecurity can feel intimidating or dry, the key is to focus on peace of mind, daily frustrations, and simplicity rather than technical jargon.

### 🚗 The Lead-In

"I always enjoy these drives because I get to meet such interesting people. When I’m not behind the wheel, I’ve actually been spending my time on a passion project. I’m developing a simple, automated program to help folks easily secure their Windows computers. The goal is to block out scammers, junk pop-ups, and malware without making people buy expensive subscription software or figure out confusing settings.
If you don't mind me asking, I'm always trying to learn how real people actually experience their computers these days..."

### 💬 The Questions


#### 1. General Use & Tech Setup


#### 44"Do you use a computer much at home to stay connected—like for email, playing games, or keeping up with family?"

"Are you using a Windows laptop or desktop, or do you mostly stick to a tablet or phone?"

#### 2. Everyday Frustrations & Fears

"What is the single most annoying thing that happens when you're using your computer?"
"Do you ever get those sudden, scary-looking pop-up warnings telling you your computer is infected or that you need to call a number? How do you usually handle those?"
"When you're online, do you generally feel safe and in control, or is there always a little bit of worry about scams or hackers lurking in the background?"

#### 3. Testing the "Solution"


#### "If there was a simple, 'one-and-done' tool that could automatically tighten up your Windows settings in the background—making it much harder for scammers to get in without changing how you normally use your computer—is that something that would give you more peace of mind?"

"When it comes to tech help, do you usually have a go-to family member you rely on, or do you prefer to handle things yourself if they are simple enough?"👋 The Fun Drop-Off Statement
"Well, here we are, safe and sound! I like to think my driving is a lot like the security program I'm building: smooth, reliable, and completely crash-free. Have a wonderful appointment, and if you want to swap any more tech stories on the ride back, you know who to ask!"
